# Sought After Co.

> Sought After Co. is a branding and website studio based in Littleton, Colorado, founded by John Mulhern. It builds custom websites for local service businesses (painters, contractors, plumbers, cleaners, roofers, landscapers and other trades) that are designed to bring in work: every inquiry in one place, simple online payments, and a Google Business Profile so the business shows up on Google Maps. Sites go live in 14 days for a fixed price.

## Packages
- [Launch](https://soughtafter.design/launch): a custom website, live in 14 days, with inquiries in one place, simple online payments and invoicing, and revisions during the build. Fixed price, quoted on a free call.
- [Launch + Grow](https://soughtafter.design/launch): everything in Launch plus Google Business Profile setup and 3 months of care (site health, basic SEO, Google profile management, lead tracking, and a check-in call every two weeks). Fixed price, quoted on a free call. Care can continue monthly after that.
- [Full studio](https://soughtafter.design/): brand identity, logo, and brand-plus-website builds, scoped on a call.

## Work
- [Jessie's coffee cart](https://soughtafter.design/jessies-coffee.html): brand, booking-ready site and lead pipeline, live in about a week.
- [Double Joy Cookies](https://soughtafter.design/double-joy-cookies.html): a custom cookie business site that takes and runs its own orders.
- [Ori Wines](https://soughtafter.design/ori-wines.html): full identity and launch site for a woman-owned Idaho winery.
